_meta.title: Experimental co-crystal / cryo-EM structures of approved protein-targeting cyclic-peptide drugs
_meta.purpose: Bound-complex (receptor + cyclic peptide) training set for a target-conditioned cyclic-peptide generator (M2c corpus)
_meta.verification: Every PDB ID verified live against RCSB data/GraphQL API (https://data.rcsb.org). resolution in Angstrom. rec_chain/pep_chain are RCSB auth_asym_ids.
_meta.suitable_definition: true = the drug (or its exact active peptide pharmacophore) is modeled as a polymer peptide chain in the real target's binding pocket, giving a usable receptor+cyclic-peptide bound complex

records.source: FKS1(S.cerevisiae)+caspofungin+Rho1 cryo-EM; target is the real fungal enzyme (not human). Giant membrane complex but caspofungin modeled as clean 6-res peptide chain H.
no co-crystal found; among FKS1/glucan-synthase structures only caspofungin (9PE1) is modeled with the drug.
no co-crystal found.
no co-crystal found.
OXTR bound to oxytocin in Gq complex (human). Premium GPCR-peptide bound complex; oxytocin is a disulfide-cyclized 9-mer (+Gly-NH2).
no co-crystal found; OXTR+oxytocin (7RYC) is the closest pharmacophore (carbetocin is a 1-deamino-O-methyl oxytocin analog).
V2R bound to arginine-vasopressin in Gs complex (human). Alt: 7DW9 (V2R+AVP, 2.6A), 7BB6 (L-state), 7R0C (AVP-V2R-arrestin2).
no co-crystal found; V2R+AVP (7KH0) is the closest pharmacophore (desmopressin = 1-deamino-8-D-Arg vasopressin).
no co-crystal found.
no co-crystal found.
V1aR bound to atosiban (human). Atosiban is an OXTR/V1aR antagonist; here cyclic 9-mer modeled as peptide chains C/D. Premium antagonist-bound GPCR complex.
SSTR2 bound to somatostatin-14 in Gi3 complex (human; receptor is SSTR2-KOR fusion). Premium GPCR-peptide complex.
SSTR2 bound to octreotide in Gi3 complex (human). Alt: 8ZBE (SSTR5+octreotide, 3.24A). Disulfide-cyclized 8-mer.
SSTR2 bound to lanreotide (human). Note: lanreotide self-assembly nanotube crystals (7Q5G/7Q5A) also exist but are NOT target complexes.
SSTR5 bound to pasireotide in Gi complex (human; receptor is B2AR-SSTR5 fusion). Cyclohexapeptide modeled as 6-res chain A.
no co-crystal found; SSTR2+octreotide/lanreotide are closest octapeptide analogs.
CTR ectodomain + truncated salmon calcitonin analogue (human receptor). Alt (full TM receptor): 7TYW (AMY1=CTR+RAMP1 + salmon calcitonin len33, cryo-EM 3.0A), 7TYY (AMY2), 6PFO (CTR ECD + sCT 16-32).
no co-crystal found (no GC-C ectodomain + agonist peptide structure in PDB).
no co-crystal found.

records.target: N-type voltage-gated Ca channel Cav2.2 (alpha-1B) + a2d1 + b3
records.source: Human Cav2.2 + omega-conotoxin MVIIA (= ziconotide, exact synthetic equivalent). Large channel but one clean disulfide-knotted 25-mer peptide chain B. Alt: 7MIY, 7VFU.
MC4R bound to bremelanotide in Gs complex (human). Cyclic 7-mer; Ca2+ in pocket. Premium GPCR-peptide complex.
MC4R bound to setmelanotide in Gs complex (human). 2.58A — excellent resolution. Alt: 7PIV. Premium.

Human cyclophilin A + cyclosporin A; CsA modeled as an 11-residue POLYMER peptide chain C (not HETATM) — ideal clean small cyclic-peptide complex. Many alts (2X2C, etc.); ternary calcineurin-CypA-CsA also available.
Human cyclophilin A + voclosporin (E-ISA247), peptide modeled as polymer chain, 2.2A. Alt: 9UPJ (Entamoeba Cyp18 + voclosporin, 1.5A, non-human).
no co-crystal of romidepsin found. Precedent for depsipeptide-HDAC thiolate-Zn binding: 3RQD (HDAC8 + largazole depsipeptide, chains C/D len5) — different drug, same mechanism.
no co-crystal of motixafortide found. Cyclic-peptide precedent at same target: 3OE0 (CXCR4 + cyclic peptide antagonist CVX15, chain I len16, X-ray 2.9A).

no DOTATATE-specific structure. Peptide moiety = DOTA-[Tyr3]-octreotate, a one-residue variant of octreotide; SSTR2+octreotide (7T11) is the direct pharmacophore complex. Pharmacophore-analog coverage, not the exact drug.
Same peptide as Lu-177 dotatate (DOTA-[Tyr3]-octreotate); SSTR2+octreotide (7T11) is the direct pharmacophore. Pharmacophore-analog coverage, not the exact drug.

Integrin alphaIIbbeta3 headpiece + eptifibatide (also carries Fab 10E5 H/L chains). Best alt (cleaner): 8T2U = full-length alphaIIbbeta3 in native lipids + eptifibatide (cryo-EM 3.1A, only chains A=alphaIIb, B=beta3, C=eptifibatide). Cyclic KGD/RGD-mimetic octapeptide. DIRECT PRECEDENT for the alphaVbeta6 RGD cyclic-peptide program.

Human C5 TE domain + macrocyclic peptide (RCSB-labeled 'Ra30303'); primary citation is literally 'Discovery of Zilucoplan: A Complement C5 Inhibitor...' -> confirmed zilucoplan-series macrocycle. Clean X-ray receptor+peptide, 2.0A.

no pegcetacoplan-specific structure. Its active moiety is a compstatin analog; 7BAG = C3b + compstatin CP40 (chain C len14, 2.0A) is the DIRECT pharmacophore complex. Alt: 2QKI (C3c + compstatin, chains G/H len15, 2.4A). Pharmacophore coverage.
no rusfertide (minihepcidin mimetic) co-crystal found. Pharmacophore precedent at same target: 6WBV = human ferroportin + hepcidin (chain B len25, +Co2+, cryo-EM 2.5A).

records.target: Ribosomal protein L11 + 23S rRNA (bacterial GTPase-associated center)
records.source: NMR-based model of thiostrepton (polymer chain C len19) on the L11-RNA complex (L11 protein chain A + 23S rRNA chain B). Direct drug + target but NMR model, bacterial, and a protein+RNA receptor; lower priority for a clean corpus.

records.target: 50S large ribosomal subunit (L11/23S rRNA region), D. radiodurans
records.source: Nosiheptide (polymer chain '5' len13) bound to the full 50S ribosome. Direct drug+target but a giant assembly at 3.7A; extract the L11/rRNA pocket for training. Lower priority.
